## Spatiotemporal Composability

The programming model behind dynamic AI runtimes: reversible effects, reactive dependencies, lifecycle races, and the limits of rollback in self-learning systems.

Read in order:

1. [Why Dynamic AI Systems Break in Two Different Directions](posts/spatiotemporal-composability/part-1-dynamic-ai-systems/index.qmd)
2. [Revertible Effects — Making Runtime Changes Undoable](posts/spatiotemporal-composability/part-2-revertible-effects/index.qmd)
3. [Reactive Coeffects — Dependencies That Control Component Lifetime](posts/spatiotemporal-composability/part-3-reactive-coeffects/index.qmd)
4. [Async Reloads, Epochs and the Race You Probably Missed](posts/spatiotemporal-composability/part-4-async-reloads-and-epochs/index.qmd)
5. [From Clever Plugin Runtime to Programming Paradigm](posts/spatiotemporal-composability/part-5-programming-paradigm/index.qmd)
